name: World Bank World Development Indicators (API v2)
access: documented public API (api.worldbank.org/v2), no key
licence: CC BY 4.0 (World Bank Open Data terms)
coverage_countries: panel + HKG, MAC, JPN, USA, WLD
variables: 29 indicators: GDP, GDPpc (current/const/PPP), GNIpc Atlas, population, GDP per worker, MVA (level/share), high-tech exports, manufactures share, merchandise trade, FDI in/outflows, patents (WIPO-sourced), R&D
notes: Database vintage recorded in wdi_source_record.json (lastupdated 2026-07-13).

name: World Bank country income classifications (OGHIST, CLASS, FY26/FY27 notes)
access: direct file download (datacatalogfiles.worldbank.org; documents.worldbank.org)
unit: category; thresholds in current US$ (Atlas GNI per capita)
notes: OGHIST.xlsx on the catalog ends at FY25; FY26 and FY27 changes taken from the official classification notes (PDF). Data-catalog API rate-limits aggressively (HTTP 429).

name: Atlas of Economic Complexity (Harvard Growth Lab) - GraphQL API
access: documented public GraphQL API (atlas.hks.harvard.edu/api/graphql), no key, <=120 req/min
licence: Atlas data; bulk files on Harvard Dataverse are CC0 1.0. Cite Growth Lab (2026).
coverage_countries: panel + JPN, USA (ECI: all ranked countries)
variables: ECI, COI, PCI (HS4), country x HS4 exports/imports/RCA/market share, Korea x partner HS4 bilateral flows
notes: Bulk Dataverse files (HS6 bilateral) sit behind a guestbook form -> manual task M3.

name: WIPO IP Statistics Data Center
access: interactive data center (no documented bulk API)
licence: WIPO terms of use (free use with attribution)
variables: resident/non-resident applications, grants, PCT filings, technology fields
notes: Resident and non-resident patent applications are already retrieved via WDI (IP.PAT.RESD/NRES, WIPO-sourced). PCT and technology-field series -> manual task M5.

name: UNIDO industrial statistics (INDSTAT / CIP)
access: TBD

name: UN Comtrade (public preview API)
access: keyless public preview API (1 period/call, <=500 records/call, call-volume quota with Retry-After)

variables: bilateral totals (reporter- and partner-reported), HS2 bilateral Korea<->partner (both directions)
notes: Totals matrix complete. HS2 dyads complete for partners fetched before quota stops; rerun is resumable. Full API (free key) -> manual task M1.

name: OECD FDI statistics by counterpart area (BMD4; historical BMD3)
access: documented public SDMX API (sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest), no key
licence: OECD terms (CC BY 4.0 for most data)
coverage_countries: reporters KOR, JPN, USA x counterparts panel + HKG, W
variables: FDI flows, positions, income by counterpart; inward/outward; directional and asset/liability principles
notes: Reporter-side confidentiality suppression for some dyad-years.

name: UNCTADstat bulk downloads
access: public bulk-download endpoint (unctadstat-api.unctad.org); unctad.org main site blocks automation (403)
variables: FDI inward/outward flows and stocks (aggregate, not bilateral)
notes: Bilateral FDI tables (2014 release) are on unctad.org -> manual task M4.

name: Korea Eximbank overseas direct investment reports (data.go.kr file dataset 3040164)
access: data.go.kr file download (anonymous, the page's own download flow; CAPTCHA limit check honoured)
licence: data.go.kr: 이용허락범위 제한 없음 (no restriction), free
coverage_countries: major destinations (VNM, CHN, SGP, IDN always; MYS, MMR, KHM, THA, PHL sometimes; LAO, BRN, TLS never)
variables: gross ODI (총투자) by region, major destination country, industry, investor size, equity share; new affiliates
unit: US$ million (reports); thousand US$ (annual 경영분석 books)
notes: 75 of 76 listed releases downloaded (20141114 has no file on the portal). Reports before 2015 give country figures mostly in narrative text (bespoke parsing needed); OECD BMD3 covers those years. The full country x year database for small partners (LAO, BRN, TLS) remains on stats.koreaexim.go.kr (manual task M4).

name: OECD TiVA 2025 (GVC exposure)
access: SDMX dataflows DSD_TIVA_* located, not yet downloaded

name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs web archive (www.mofa.go.kr boards)

redistribution: derived measures; full texts only where KOGL type permits
variables: title, date, department, body text, attachments list, board, language
notes: Inventory of 13 boards complete; full text for all speeches/summit/plan boards and for alias hits of large boards; Diplomatic White Paper PDFs.
